site.title: SearchCans Agent Skills
site.description: Official, account-aware Agent Skills for SearchCans SERP, Reader, File Extraction, Screenshot, and Account APIs.

skills.name: searchcans-deep-research
skills.title: SearchCans Deep Research
skills.best_for: Current market, competitor, technology, policy, company, and product research
skills.delivers: A bounded, evidence-led brief with traceable URLs, conflicts, and uncertainty
skills.account_policy: Checks one pre-flight, caps Reader sources, and limits concurrency to reported lanes.
skills.example: Use $searchcans-deep-research to investigate the current SERP API market in the US.

skills.name: searchcans-serp-content-gap
skills.title: SearchCans SERP Content Gap
skills.best_for: Keyword research, search-intent analysis, competitor-page review, and content opportunity planning
skills.delivers: A localized Google or Bing SERP opportunity brief grounded in observed result features
skills.account_policy: Checks multi-page jobs and caps page scope when the planned request count exceeds the budget.
skills.example: Use $searchcans-serp-content-gap to analyze this keyword in the US market.

skills.name: searchcans-reader-seo-audit
skills.title: SearchCans Reader SEO Audit
skills.best_for: Web-to-Markdown extraction, RAG input checks, dynamic pages, PDFs, Office files, and page-level SEO/GEO review
skills.delivers: An extraction report with observable canonical, H1, meta-description, JSON-LD, file, and screenshot signals
skills.account_policy: Runs a pre-flight automatically for higher-cost proxy requests and keeps standard extraction lightweight.
skills.example: Use $searchcans-reader-seo-audit to inspect this page for extraction and SEO-ready signals.

skills.name: searchcans-market-watch
skills.title: SearchCans Market Watch
skills.best_for: Competitor, category, launch, PR, and news monitoring with optional snapshot comparison
skills.delivers: A Google, Google News, Bing, and Reader evidence snapshot with URL-level baseline differences
skills.account_policy: Checks one pre-flight, caps selected Reader news sources, and respects reported lane count.
skills.example: Use $searchcans-market-watch to create a US market snapshot for this category.

skills.name: searchcans-product-serp-brief
skills.title: SearchCans Product SERP Brief
skills.best_for: E-commerce category research, merchant discovery, product-page planning, and localized merchandising briefs
skills.delivers: A Google Shopping, web, images, and optional merchant-page evidence brief
skills.account_policy: Checks the three SERP calls plus explicit Reader URLs and caps only source reads when needed.
skills.example: Use $searchcans-product-serp-brief to research this product category in the US.

skills.name: searchcans-content-format-brief
skills.title: SearchCans Content Format Brief
skills.best_for: Editorial format discovery, visual/video search research, and SEO/GEO content format planning
skills.delivers: A localized inventory of Google web, images, videos, and short-video result formats
skills.account_policy: Checks one pre-flight per requested format and caps the selected formats in a fixed priority order.
skills.example: Use $searchcans-content-format-brief to map localized content formats for this topic.

skills.name: searchcans-rag-source-curator
skills.title: SearchCans RAG Source Curator
skills.best_for: Grounding packs, source curation, knowledge-base intake, and pre-ingestion evidence checks
skills.delivers: A small, domain-diverse Reader/File source manifest with evidence-readiness gating
skills.account_policy: Checks search plus Reader/File source budget, caps selected sources, and limits workers to reported lanes.
skills.example: Use $searchcans-rag-source-curator to curate sources for this RAG question.
